# Choice — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A single checkbox or radio control with a clickable label and built-in `error` / `warning` outline states. Use `FormField` when you need a description, hint message, or label-above layout.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.

Before reuse, read the complete implementation, types, styles and local imports listed below. Use the HTML Skill lookup command with `--id extensions.choice --read-source` to read the source closure. Workspace creation copies the full tree. For a standalone/existing app, run the bundled `cobalt-project.mjs copy-source --out <project>`; it copies source without installing dependencies or replacing existing files.
